en: Color postcard showing a busy central square with a decorative Zsolnay fountain in the foreground, featuring ornate ceramic details and animal heads. Surrounding it are flower beds, 1960s-era cars, buses, and pedestrians. In the background stands a domed former mosque on a hill-facing square with additional statues and buildings. The reverse side has Hungarian handwriting, a red Hungarian stamp, and printed captions indicating the subject of the card.
